modes.name: Narrative campaign
modes.objective: Seize the Grand Calloni Hotel and retain a viable Marine force through the Round 12 resolution.

modes.name: Seize and hold
modes.objective: Control the Grand Calloni Hotel at the end of Round 8.

modes.name: Rescue or rendition
modes.objective: Secure more designated high-value people than the opposing force.

locations.name: Grand Calloni Hotel
locations.description: Six-storey objective, observation post, town hall, and primary tourist landmark.

locations.name: Neustadt Building
locations.description: Thick-walled refuge with a randomized encounter.

locations.name: The Barrows
locations.description: Barricaded homes whose residents may reveal enemy positions.

locations.name: Old Police Station
locations.description: Storm-damaged station occupied by journalists and their drone.

locations.name: Warehouse Complex
locations.description: Three commercial structures including the CGCC telecommunications offices.

locations.name: 8-Twelve
locations.description: Convenience store, grocery, and base for Ako Maryese and his associates.

locations.name: North Market
locations.description: Rubble-filled market with randomized LPM, civilian, or PDF contacts.

locations.name: South Market
locations.description: Abandoned stalls subject to recurring stray mortar impacts.

locations.name: Shattered Lines
locations.description: Entrenchments, barriers, blast craters, and an RPG-7 cache.

locations.name: Calloni Clinic
locations.description: Operating clinic, medical staff, patients, and strict weapons restrictions.

locations.name: LPM Safe House
locations.description: Three-storey apartment concealing an LPM SOF element.

timeline.title: Insertion
timeline.summary: The Marine platoon enters silent Calloni from the southwest while civilians flee south.

timeline.title: Overhead
timeline.summary: Two unidentified quadcopters pass over the Marines; shooting or failed jamming can alert the LPM.

timeline.title: Bad omens
timeline.summary: Distant fighting and an approaching LPM mechanized column are reported.

timeline.title: First contact
timeline.summary: Militia may fire from the building west of the clinic if Marines are exposed to it.

timeline.title: The LPM arrives
timeline.summary: A reduced LPM light infantry platoon enters near K-1 and advances south along the warehouses.

timeline.title: An underground figure
timeline.summary: Ako may offer a sewer route that inserts a small Marine team into the hotel.

timeline.title: Complications
timeline.summary: High observers may locate LPM mortars; otherwise nearby PDF survivors reveal a contact.

timeline.title: Seek and destroy
timeline.summary: If alerted, LPM attack drones prioritize Marine leadership and anti-armor teams.

timeline.title: Occupied
timeline.summary: Hotel civilians emerge, while reconnaissance drones may cue an LPM mortar unit.

timeline.title: The other shoe drops
timeline.summary: Two LPM mechanized infantry squads enter near I-1 and drive toward the hotel.

timeline.title: Last call
timeline.summary: Unengaged LPM elements rush to deny Marine entry to the hotel.

timeline.title: Victory and death
timeline.summary: A third ZBL-09 arrives and control of the hotel determines the final narrative outcome.
